issue_title: Homepage performance persistently below 85 for 8+ consecutive audits (LCP > 6.4 s)
issue_body:
## Homepage Performance Regression — 8+ Consecutive Audits Below 85

**Audited:** 2026-08-03T11:43:20.265Z
**Page:** `/`

### Current scores
| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Performance | 73 |
| LCP | 6447 ms |
| CLS | 0.015 |
| TBT | 175 ms |

### History
The homepage has scored 73 on every audit for at least 8 consecutive runs, with LCP consistently above 6.4 s. Previous audit: 73 / 6654 ms. No structural fix has been applied across any of these audits.

### Root cause (likely)
The hero image (above-the-fold) is not preloaded and is likely served in a non-optimised format/size, causing a slow LCP. Render-blocking resources may also be delaying first paint.

### Recommended fix
1. Add `<link rel="preload" as="image" href="...hero..." imagesrcset="..." imagesizes="...">` in `<head>`.
2. Serve the hero image in WebP or AVIF, sized appropriately for mobile (≤ 800 px wide).
3. Audit and defer any render-blocking JS/CSS above the fold.

This is the single highest-impact improvement available on the site and has now persisted for 8+ audits without action.
